title: I've Been Looking For a Specific Film For Years and I'm Losing My Mind

commenti.body:
As you may have discovered, mubi lists it in their catalog but it's noted as "not currently playing." https://mubi.com/en/us/films/painter-2021

You could try contacting them, https://mubi.com/en/contact, and asking if/when they plan on making it available again. 

I also checked some underground sources, including karagarga, and some other Hirschbiegel works are available but not this one.

Looks interesting. Maybe you can email the distributor and ask? I found a web site [https://dermaler.der-filmverleih.de/kontakt/](https://dermaler.der-filmverleih.de/kontakt/) with an email address.

Edited for length: that email address is [info@der-filmverleih.de](mailto:info@der-filmverleih.de).
From what I can find, it played in festivals from 2021-2022 and played in German theaters in 2023. No streaming or physical release I can find. Knowing German would help the search.
Also, ask a librarian. They can work magic with some things. And if you're near a college or university, they too can get ahold of things obscure.
